rationale: Central data container for the entire pipeline. Typed Optional[np.ndarray] fields, .set()/.get() access with provenance tracking, SHA-256 content hash, .to_npz()/.from_npz() serialization via _ARRAY_CHANNELS registry. Architecture is sound. Critical flaw: terrain_ao and terrain_displacement are declared as Optional[np.ndarray] but NOT in _ARRAY_CHANNELS, so they silently drop on serialization round-trips — production data loss bug.
aaa_equivalent: Guerrilla Games' terrain layer stack in Decima (channels registered per-feature with full serialization contracts)
critical_flaws: terrain_ao and terrain_displacement fields NOT in _ARRAY_CHANNELS — silently dropped on to_npz/from_npz
simulate_fold_deformation() in terrain_stratigraphy bypasses .set() provenance via direct stack.height = ...
strengths: Typed dataclass with Optional[np.ndarray] for every channel
SHA-256 content hash for cache invalidation
water_surface_mask and water_surface_elevation_m both declared AND in _ARRAY_CHANNELS (W-1 fix confirmed)
upgrade_note: Add terrain_ao and terrain_displacement to _ARRAY_CHANNELS tuple immediately — silent data loss in production. Also audit every other Optional[np.ndarray] field for _ARRAY_CHANNELS registration completeness.

rationale: Proper provenance tracking — records pass name, timestamp, and channel name on every write. Guards against unknown channel names. Clean interface.
aaa_equivalent: Naughty Dog's terrain layer write interface with audit trail
strengths: Validates channel name exists before writing
Single point of truth for all channel writes
upgrade_note: Consider adding dtype validation — reject float64 arrays to enforce float32 consistency.

rationale: Clean channel read with KeyError on unknown channels. Consistent counterpart to .set().
aaa_equivalent: Standard typed channel accessor
upgrade_note: Minor: consider returning a read-only view to prevent accidental in-place mutation of stack arrays.

rationale: Serializes all _ARRAY_CHANNELS to .npz with SHA-256 manifest. Correct for registered channels. Critical gap: terrain_ao and terrain_displacement not in _ARRAY_CHANNELS so they silently vanish. No version header for forward compatibility.
aaa_equivalent: Guerrilla terrain tile serializer — but missing channel registration completeness
critical_flaws: terrain_ao and terrain_displacement silently excluded from serialization
No schema version header — no forward/backward compatibility path
strengths: SHA-256 per-channel content hash in manifest
upgrade_note: Register terrain_ao and terrain_displacement in _ARRAY_CHANNELS. Add schema_version field to manifest JSON.

rationale: Inverse of to_npz. Same registration gap: terrain_ao/displacement silently absent after round-trip. No version check means future format changes will silently produce wrong data.
aaa_equivalent: Deserializer matching the incomplete serializer above
critical_flaws: terrain_ao and terrain_displacement not restored — silent data loss
No schema version validation
strengths: Graceful handling of missing optional channels
upgrade_note: Fix _ARRAY_CHANNELS registration first. Add version guard with migration path.

rationale: SHA-256 hash over all populated channels for cache invalidation. Deterministic ordering via sorted channel names. Used for tile caching throughout the pipeline.
aaa_equivalent: Standard content-addressable cache key
strengths: Deterministic: sorts channel names before hashing
upgrade_note: Hash also excludes terrain_ao/displacement due to _ARRAY_CHANNELS gap — cascading issue from the registration bug.

rationale: Dataclass expressing DAG contract: produces_channels, requires_channels, overrides, optional_channels. Clean design that enables the pipeline orchestrator to auto-order passes without manual dependency specification.
aaa_equivalent: Frostbite/Decima render graph node descriptor
strengths: Explicit produces/requires contract enables DAG auto-ordering
overrides for explicit channel replacement semantics
upgrade_note: Add runtime validation that produces_channels are actually registered in _ARRAY_CHANNELS.

rationale: DAG-based pipeline orchestrator. Topological sort of passes, dependency validation, execution with timing. Solid architecture for managing 12+ interdependent terrain passes.
aaa_equivalent: Avalanche Studios' modular terrain pipeline orchestrator
critical_flaws: No cycle detection reported with clear error messaging
Pass failure handling unclear — does one failed pass abort the run or skip?
strengths: Topological sort for correct execution order
upgrade_note: Add explicit cycle detection with named cycle reporting. Define fail-fast vs. skip-failed-pass behavior.

rationale: 4-cascade shadow clipmap with LOD0-LOD3. Vectorized horizon-scan, min() composite across cascades, struct-packed mini-EXR writer. Architecturally sound. Degraded by nearest-neighbor sampling in _bake_single_cascade (no bilinear) and the DAG contract writes baked_cloud_shadow but not cloud_shadow — an intentional rename but causes confusion with dependent passes.
aaa_equivalent: Naughty Dog TLOU2 terrain shadow bake — but with bilinear sampling
critical_flaws: _bake_single_cascade uses nearest-neighbor sample, not bilinear — produces staircase artifacts on LOD seams
upgrade_note: Replace nearest-neighbor with bilinear interpolation in _bake_single_cascade. Document the baked_cloud_shadow channel name explicitly.

rationale: Bakes one LOD cascade of terrain shadow. Core horizon-scan logic is vectorized and correct. Nearest-neighbor sampling produces visible staircase artifacts at cascade borders under oblique sun angles.
aaa_equivalent: CDProjekt terrain cascade baker — but missing bilinear
critical_flaws: Nearest-neighbor sample — no bilinear interpolation at cascade boundaries
upgrade_note: Use scipy.ndimage.map_coordinates with order=1 (bilinear) for sub-texel lookups.

rationale: Orchestrates 4-cascade bake and writes baked_cloud_shadow channel. Correct cascade ordering. DAG channel naming follows W-1 pattern (produces baked_cloud_shadow, not cloud_shadow).
aaa_equivalent: Standard clipmap cascade orchestrator
strengths: Final composite via np.minimum across cascades
upgrade_note: Minor: log cascade timings to help diagnose performance regressions.

rationale: Struct-packed binary EXR writer. Correct 16-bit half-float encoding. Minimal header for shadow clipmap distribution. Avoids openexr dependency by writing raw binary.
aaa_equivalent: Minimal EXR shadow tile writer
strengths: Includes minimal EXR header for compatibility
upgrade_note: Consider adding multi-channel support for future normal-map shadow integration.

rationale: Implements Heitz & Neyret 2019 histogram-preserving blending + Mikkelsen 2022 hex-tiling. Python bake pipeline is correctly rank-based (argsort+linspace). Manifest name mismatch resolved. Major issue: HLSL HistogramPreservingBlend is contrast-correction approximation only, not true CDF transform from Heitz Eq. 10. This means shader-side blending diverges from the baked LUT.
aaa_equivalent: Respawn Entertainment terrain texture variation system (with full histogram preservation in shader)
critical_flaws: HLSL HistogramPreservingBlend uses contrast-correction approximation, not Heitz Eq. 10 true CDF inversion — Python bake and HLSL shader are mathematically inconsistent
strengths: Python histogram bake correct: rank-based equalization via argsort + linspace
Hex-tiling UV offsets: Mikkelsen 2022 RectToHex/HexToRect transforms
Power-4 smooth blend weights for hex cells
upgrade_note: Implement true Heitz Eq. 10 in HLSL: invert the CDF via Gaussian approximation or precomputed 1D LUT texture.

rationale: Correct rank-based histogram equalization via argsort + linspace. Matches Heitz 2019 offline bake specification. Produces the T(x) and T^-1(x) LUT arrays used at runtime.
aaa_equivalent: Correct offline bake per Heitz & Neyret 2019 EGSR paper
strengths: argsort-based rank normalization is the correct approach
Produces both forward and inverse LUT
upgrade_note: Consider 16-bit LUT texture output to reduce quantization error in the shader inversion step.

rationale: Generates HLSL shader source with hex-tiling and histogram-preserving blending. Hex-tiling math is correct (Mikkelsen 2022). HistogramPreservingBlend function uses contrast-correction approximation only — diverges from the correct Python bake. Result: in-game texture variation will not match the baked appearance.
aaa_equivalent: Incorrect approximation vs. Respawn/Guerrilla full CDF inversion
critical_flaws: HistogramPreservingBlend is contrast-correction only, not Heitz Eq. 10 — produces tonal drift vs. baked reference
strengths: Hex-tiling UV math correct per Mikkelsen 2022
Power-4 smooth weights for hex cell blending
upgrade_note: Replace contrast-correction with Gaussian CDF approximation or LUT texture sample in HLSL. See Heitz 2019 supplemental code.

rationale: Correct implementation of Mikkelsen 2022 RectToHex coordinate transform. Used for hex-tiling UV generation. Exact match to paper.
aaa_equivalent: Direct implementation of Mikkelsen 2022 JCGT hex-tiling

rationale: Correct inverse of _rect_to_hex. Used for converting hex vertex offsets back to texture UV space.
aaa_equivalent: Mikkelsen 2022 HexToRect exact implementation

rationale: Writes JSON manifest with shader name, LUT paths, and blend parameters. Name mismatch previously resolved. Clean serialization.
aaa_equivalent: Standard shader manifest writer
strengths: Includes LUT file paths for runtime binding
upgrade_note: Minor: include a schema_version field for forward compatibility.

rationale: Fourier-domain fold deformation with hardness-coupled erosion. The geological approach is sound. Fatal provenance flaw: writes via direct stack.height = ... bypassing .set() tracking — the pipeline cannot know this pass modified height, breaking DAG dependency analysis and cache invalidation.
aaa_equivalent: Terrain folding in RDR2's procedural geology — but with proper channel tracking
critical_flaws: Direct stack.height = assignment bypasses .set() provenance tracking
DAG cannot detect height modification — pass ordering and cache invalidation broken for downstream passes
upgrade_note: Replace stack.height = ... with stack.set('height', ..., pass_name='terrain_stratigraphy') immediately.

rationale: Dataclass for a single geological layer. Well-named fields: base_height, thickness, hardness, color_tint. Used as input to the stratigraphic simulation.
aaa_equivalent: Geology layer descriptor in terrain procedural systems
upgrade_note: Add porosity/permeability fields for future water table simulation.

rationale: Builds N=5-9 layer stack with randomized thickness and hardness. Seeded RNG for reproducibility. Reasonable defaults for dark fantasy geological variety.
aaa_equivalent: Procedural geology layer generator
strengths: Parameterized layer count and thickness range
upgrade_note: Consider adding a 'formation_type' parameter (marine/volcanic/metamorphic) to bias layer properties.

rationale: Applies differential erosion based on layer hardness. Softer layers erode faster, creating natural banding and overhangs. Uses stack height to determine which layer each cell is in.
aaa_equivalent: Differential erosion per Geoscientific Model Development papers
strengths: Hardness-coupled erosion rate is physically motivated
Banding effect produces natural rock strata appearance
upgrade_note: Consider adding lateral undercutting for overhangs (harder layer above softer).

rationale: Typed dataclass for a single PBR texture layer. All standard channels present: albedo, normal, roughness, height_displacement, AO, metallic, tiling_scale, texel_density, color_space. no_displacement_reason field is an elegant way to suppress false-positive validation warnings.
aaa_equivalent: Standard PBR layer descriptor (UE5 terrain layer)
critical_flaws: No runtime dtype enforcement — np.ndarray fields can be any dtype/shape without warning
strengths: texel_density_m field enables consistent resolution contracts
upgrade_note: Add __post_init__ dtype/shape validation for numpy arrays.

rationale: Container for multiple TextureLayers with add_layer, validate, and normalized_weights methods. normalize_weights handles zero-sum gracefully. validate returns list[str] instead of list[ValidationIssue] — inconsistent with rest of pipeline validation system.
aaa_equivalent: Splatmap layer stack management in game engines
critical_flaws: validate() returns list[str] not list[ValidationIssue] — inconsistent type contract with terrain_validation.py
strengths: normalized_weights handles zero-sum denominator (maps to uniform)
validate checks all required PBR channels
upgrade_note: Return list[ValidationIssue] from validate() to match pipeline convention.

rationale: Simple append to layers list. No duplicate layer_id check.
aaa_equivalent: Basic list append
critical_flaws: No duplicate layer_id detection — silently creates duplicate layers
upgrade_note: Add duplicate layer_id guard with ValueError.

rationale: Checks all required PBR channels per layer, weight_map bounds, terrain_mask_source. Returns list[str] instead of ValidationIssue objects. AO warning (not error) is appropriate. The weight_map bounds check correctly uses 1e-5 tolerance.
aaa_equivalent: Asset validation in Quixel Bridge integration
critical_flaws: Returns list[str] not list[ValidationIssue] — caller cannot distinguish error severity
No check for matching spatial resolution between layers
upgrade_note: Return structured ValidationIssue objects. Add cross-layer resolution consistency check.

rationale: Stacks per-layer weight maps and normalizes so they sum to 1.0 per-pixel. np.where(total < 1e-8, 1.0, total) correctly handles zero-sum pixels by distributing uniform weight. Returns float32 (H, W, N_layers) array.
aaa_equivalent: Splatmap normalization in Unity TerrainData
upgrade_note: Consider a check that all weight_maps have matching (H, W) — currently will raise cryptic np.stack error on shape mismatch.

rationale: Orchestrates the 12-step AAA terrain generation pipeline in correct order: geology→erosion→water→vegetation→roads→props→lighting→export. All steps present in correct sequence. Step 11 _generate_water_body_specs is trivially simple (70th-percentile threshold only, no Strahler ordering, no multi-basin analysis).
aaa_equivalent: Guerrilla Games / Horizon terrain pipeline orchestrator
critical_flaws: Step 11 _generate_water_body_specs is a single-threshold heuristic — no hydrological network analysis
strengths: All 12 steps present in correct order
Each step is a clearly named private method
upgrade_note: Step 11 needs Strahler stream ordering and multi-basin lake detection to produce AAA-quality water body specs.

rationale: Executes all 12 steps with per-step timing and error handling. Correctly returns TerrainMaskStack after all steps. Checkpointing support for long runs.
aaa_equivalent: Standard pipeline execution with progress reporting
upgrade_note: Consider adding per-step memory usage tracking to identify leaks in long generation runs.

rationale: Invokes stratigraphic simulation, fold deformation, base heightmap generation. Correctly handles seeding for reproducibility.
aaa_equivalent: Geology pass in AAA terrain pipeline
upgrade_note: None needed beyond fixing simulate_fold_deformation provenance bypass in the called module.

rationale: Applies hydraulic and thermal erosion to the base heightmap. Standard approach.
aaa_equivalent: Hydraulic erosion pass (ErosionBrush in World Creator)
upgrade_note: Consider adding wind erosion in this step rather than as a separate pass for coherent geology.

rationale: Computes D8 flow accumulation, river routing, lake detection. Foundation for waterfall placement in step 5.
aaa_equivalent: Hydrological network extraction pass
strengths: D8 flow accumulation is physically correct

rationale: Assigns material/biome zones based on height, slope, moisture, and aspect. Stochastic noise for natural boundaries.
aaa_equivalent: Biome distribution in RDR2 terrain
upgrade_note: Consider altitude-temperature coupling for more physically accurate biome transitions.

rationale: Delegates to terrain_waterfalls.pass_waterfalls. Correctly passes water network outputs as inputs.
aaa_equivalent: Waterfall placement pass

rationale: A* road routing with terrain cost function. 3-zone carving (road/shoulder/blend). Rune-style approach.
aaa_equivalent: Procedural road carving in KCD2/RDR2

rationale: Vegetation placement with ecotone blending, competition, and Poisson-disk spacing. Delegates to terrain_vegetation_depth.
aaa_equivalent: Vegetation scatter pass in Horizon/TLOU2

rationale: Places terrain props (rocks, debris, clutter). Less sophisticated than vegetation — basic slope/height filtering without competition or ecotone logic.
aaa_equivalent: Prop scatter pass — simpler than vegetation
critical_flaws: No competition filtering between prop types
No ecotone blending
upgrade_note: Add prop-type competition masks similar to vegetation step.

rationale: Invokes 4-cascade shadow clipmap bake. Correctly passes heightmap and sun direction.
aaa_equivalent: Shadow bake pass

rationale: Applies 5-stage weathering model to vegetation and props. Correctly delegates to weathering.py.
aaa_equivalent: Weathering pass in KCD2

rationale: Generates water body specs using a single 70th-percentile threshold on flow accumulation. No Strahler stream ordering, no basin analysis, no lake type classification, no flow rate estimation. This is a placeholder that would never survive AAA review for a water-heavy dark fantasy world.
aaa_equivalent: No AAA equivalent uses a single percentile threshold for water body classification
critical_flaws: Single percentile threshold — cannot distinguish lakes from rivers from ponds
No Strahler stream ordering
No flow rate estimation (needed for waterfall physics in step 5)
No multi-basin watershed analysis
strengths: At least produces some water body output rather than None
upgrade_note: Implement Strahler ordering, basin detection (priority flood), and Manning-based flow rate. This feeds waterfall physics so getting it wrong cascades errors.

rationale: Delegates to terrain_unity_export.export_unity_manifest. Correctly passes all required stack channels. Validates bit-depth contract before export.
aaa_equivalent: Export pass matching Unity HDRP terrain importer spec

rationale: Checks (n-1) & (n-2) == 0 for Unity heightmap resolution validation. This tests that n-1 is a power of 2 (Unity requires 2^k+1 resolutions). The bitwise check is correct for n > 1 but will return true for n=1 and n=2 due to how the AND works. Edge cases are unlikely in practice.
aaa_equivalent: Unity resolution validator
critical_flaws: n=1 and n=2 pass the check incorrectly (edge cases)
strengths: Correct bitwise check for power-of-2+1 resolutions
upgrade_note: Add n > 2 guard: return n > 2 and (n-1) & (n-2) == 0.

rationale: Swaps (x, z, y) for Z-up Blender to Y-up Unity conversion. Correct axis mapping matching Unity's left-handed Y-up coordinate system.
aaa_equivalent: Standard Blender→Unity coordinate conversion
strengths: Correct Z-up to Y-up axis swap
Handles both position and direction vectors
upgrade_note: Document handedness change (right-handed → left-handed) in comments.

rationale: Flips G-channel of normal map for OpenGL→DirectX convention. Correct for Unity HDRP which uses DirectX normal conventions.
aaa_equivalent: Standard OpenGL→DirectX normal map flip

rationale: Packs HDRP Mask Map as RGBA float32: R=Metallic, G=AO, B=Detail, A=Smoothness. Broadcast-safe for scalar or array inputs. Matches Unity HDRP MaskMap specification exactly.
aaa_equivalent: Unity HDRP Mask Map packing per Graphics Compositor spec

rationale: Writes numpy array to disk with SHA-256, dtype, and shape metadata. _flip_for_unity (Y-axis inversion) and _ensure_little_endian are both applied. Metadata tracking enables integrity verification on the Unity import side.
aaa_equivalent: Terrain tile writer with integrity metadata
strengths: Y-axis flip for Unity heightmap convention
upgrade_note: Consider adding a format version field to the metadata for future format migrations.

rationale: JSON file writer with SHA-256. Simple but reliable. Includes indent=2 for human readability.
aaa_equivalent: Standard JSON manifest writer

rationale: Serializes cliff/cave mesh specs including vertex positions, face indices, UV coords, and drip_edge_indices. Correct Unity coordinate conversion (Z-up→Y-up). Drip edges for waterfall VFX anchor points is a nice AAA-grade detail.
aaa_equivalent: Mesh spec serialization in RDR2 cliff placement
upgrade_note: Consider adding LOD mesh specs per cliff asset.

rationale: Full HDRP Water Surface + Unreal MF_WaterSurface parameters. Lake/river/waterfall material variants with appropriate Gerstner wave counts (3 vs 6 for hero). Beer-Lambert k=0.35, Schlick f0=0.02/power=5.0. These are research-grade PBR water parameters matching Hable/Lagarde.
aaa_equivalent: Guerrilla Horizon water shader parameter pack
strengths: Hero surface uses 6 Gerstner waves vs 3 for LOD
Schlick fresnel parameters match standard water (f0=0.02)
upgrade_note: Consider adding wind direction coupling to Gerstner wave parameters.

rationale: Serializes VFX particle emitter specs with Z-up→Y-up coordinate conversion. Correctly skips normal scaling (direction vectors are not scaled by world_scale). Position conversion is correct.
aaa_equivalent: VFX anchor export for Niagara/VFX Graph integration

rationale: Hex string to [0,1] float RGB. Error fallback returns [0,0,0] with warning. Simple utility with defensive handling.
aaa_equivalent: Color utility
strengths: Error fallback prevents crash on malformed input
upgrade_note: Support both #RRGGBB and RRGGBB without hash prefix.

rationale: Reads default layer metadata from terrain_materials_v2.default_dark_fantasy_rules(). Correct delegation pattern. Vulnerable to import-time side effects from the materials module.
aaa_equivalent: Default material layer metadata provider
upgrade_note: Cache the result to avoid repeated imports in tight loops.

rationale: BFS 8-connected component labeling in pure Python. Functionally correct but O(N) BFS in Python for a potentially multi-megapixel binary mask is slow. scipy.ndimage.label would be 10-100x faster.
aaa_equivalent: scipy.ndimage.label equivalent (but 100x slower)
critical_flaws: Pure Python BFS — 10-100x slower than scipy.ndimage.label for large terrain masks
Memory inefficient: builds full pixel list per component

rationale: World-space AABB from component pixel set. Correct Unity coordinate conversion. Simple and correct.
aaa_equivalent: Component AABB calculator

rationale: Samples terrain height over component pixels to get vertical Z extent for gameplay zone bounds. Correct sampling approach.
aaa_equivalent: Height-aware zone bounds for audio/gameplay
strengths: Used for audio zone Z bounds
upgrade_note: Consider using the 5th/95th percentile rather than min/max to avoid outlier spikes.

rationale: Builds the unity_import_descriptor.json with schema_version=1.0, all terrain asset paths, and coordinate metadata. Clean output format for Unity importer scripts.
aaa_equivalent: Asset import descriptor in AAA pipeline integration
strengths: Full path listing for all asset types

rationale: Single vector Z-up to Y-up conversion [x, z, y]. Correct axis swap.
aaa_equivalent: Standard axis conversion utility

rationale: Applies _zup_to_unity_vector to both min and max of a bounding box. Correct.
aaa_equivalent: AABB coordinate conversion
strengths: Correct conversion for both min and max

rationale: Central-difference normal computation from heightmap. Correct 8-neighbor central difference scheme with boundary clamping.
aaa_equivalent: Standard terrain normal computation

rationale: Quantizes float [0,1] density to uint16 * max_density. Correct scaling. No dithering for high-frequency density variation.
aaa_equivalent: Detail mesh density quantizer
strengths: uint16 output matches Unity detail density format
upgrade_note: Add ordered dithering to reduce quantization banding on smooth density gradients.

rationale: Writes Unity alphamap format: global normalize across all layers, RGBA uint8, round-half-up quantization, TerrainLayer asset path hints. Correctly handles >4 layers by splitting into multiple splatmap groups. This is a non-trivial Unity format requirement that most implementations get wrong.
aaa_equivalent: Unity TerrainData.alphamapTextures writer
strengths: Correct global normalization across all layers
Handles >4 layers via multiple RGBA splatmaps
Round-half-up quantization to reduce systematic bias
TerrainLayer path hints for Unity importer
upgrade_note: None needed — this is correct Unity splatmap format.

rationale: Master export orchestrator writing all terrain assets: heightmap, normals, splatmaps, HDRP mask map, detail layers, wildlife zones, gameplay zones, audio zones, tree positions, decals, mesh specs, particle emitters, water shader manifest, seam contract. Validates required fields and bit-depth contract before writing. Returns dual manifest.json + unity_import_descriptor.json.
aaa_equivalent: Guerrilla/Naughty Dog terrain asset export pipeline
critical_flaws: _iter_connected_components called on large masks — potential performance bottleneck
strengths: Comprehensive: all terrain asset types covered
Correct Unity format for all asset types
upgrade_note: Replace _iter_connected_components with scipy.ndimage.label. Consider chunked writing for tiles > 4k resolution.

rationale: Generates audio zone JSON with per-class ambient sound parameters. class_params LUT (0-7) covers silence through water/wind/combat/forest. Connected components with terrain height bounds for 3D audio. Well-designed for runtime audio zone triggering.
aaa_equivalent: Horizon Zero Dawn audio zone placement
upgrade_note: Consider adding reverb parameters per class for cave/forest differentiation.

rationale: 7-class gameplay zone taxonomy (safe/combat/stealth/exploration/boss_arena/narrative/puzzle). Connected components per class with 2D footprint. Correct for gameplay systems integration.
aaa_equivalent: CDPR gameplay zone export in Witcher/Cyberpunk
strengths: 7 meaningful zone types covering full dark fantasy gameplay loop
upgrade_note: Add danger_rating field per zone to drive enemy density systems.

rationale: Custom exception class for terrain validation failures. Carries ValidationIssue list for structured error reporting.
aaa_equivalent: Typed validation exception

rationale: Structured validation issue with channel, severity, message, and optional fix suggestion. Used throughout the validation pipeline for structured error reporting.

strengths: Optional fix suggestion for actionable output

rationale: Validates that all channels are in expected [0,1] or [0,N] ranges based on channel type. Catches out-of-range values that indicate upstream computation errors.

strengths: Detailed issue messages with actual range

aaa_equivalent: No equivalent — broken validator has no AAA counterpart
critical_flaws: DEFAULT_VALIDATORS always passes baseline_stack=None
Function receives None baseline and returns immediately with no issues — never diffs anything
Entire protected zone validation is silently disabled in production
strengths: The function signature and logic are correct — only the call site is broken

rationale: Validates D8 flow accumulation consistency, ensures water channels are connected, checks minimum flow accumulation thresholds. Sound validation logic.
aaa_equivalent: Hydrological network consistency check
upgrade_note: Add check that waterfall lip cells have non-zero flow accumulation.

rationale: Checks vegetation density channels are within per-biome expected ranges. Catches over/under-seeding issues from the vegetation pass.

rationale: Validates that all channels intended for uint16 export are within [0, 65535] and that float channels are float32 (not float64). Critical export-quality gate. Called by export_unity_manifest before writing.

strengths: Catches float64 channels that would cause silent precision issues

rationale: Returns the default list of validators run by the pipeline. Critical issue: always passes baseline_stack=None to validate_protected_zones_untouched, permanently disabling that validator. The list is otherwise comprehensive.

critical_flaws: validate_protected_zones_untouched always called with None baseline — silent no-op
Production terrain pipelines running with this have no protected zone validation
strengths: Easy to extend with new validators

rationale: Beer-Lambert light transmission through stacked vegetation layers. I = I0 * exp(-k * LAI) where k is species-specific extinction coefficient. Physically correct for forest light modeling. LAI (Leaf Area Index) per layer enables per-species attenuation rates.
aaa_equivalent: Forest light model in TLOU2/Horizon vegetation systems
strengths: Beer-Lambert is the correct physical model
upgrade_note: Consider adding diffuse upwelling (reflected light from understory) for more accurate forest floor lighting.

rationale: 3-tier LOD vegetation placement: near (0.6×density), mid (1.0×), far (1.8×). Poisson disk from scatter engine, ecotone blending between biomes, 9-step filter pipeline (moisture/altitude/slope/competition/etc). Comprehensive placement logic that matches AAA vegetation scatter pipelines.
aaa_equivalent: Horizon Zero Dawn vegetation scatter pipeline
strengths: Ecotone blending for natural biome transitions
9-step filter pipeline covers all ecological constraints
upgrade_note: Add wind corridor cutouts (high-wind areas suppress tall vegetation).

rationale: Models allelopathic plant competition — some species suppress others within radius. Correct use of distance transforms for efficient radius computation. Black walnut-style exclusion zones for dark fantasy realism.
aaa_equivalent: Plant competition modeling — rare in games, present in Horizon

rationale: Bridson Poisson-disk sampling for clearing placement with per-clearing radius and smoothstep edge blending. Clearings are a classic gameplay necessity in forest terrain. Correct use of rejection sampling.
aaa_equivalent: Clearing placement in RDR2/Witcher forest terrain
strengths: Smoothstep edge blending for soft clearing boundaries
upgrade_note: Consider weighting clearing placement toward flat areas for campsite/encounter usability.

rationale: Computes per-vertex wind sway parameters as vertex colors: R=sway_strength, G=sway_frequency, B=phase_offset, A=trunk_sway. Height-weighted sway, perlin-phase variation, and trunk anchor clamping. Standard approach for AAA wind vertex color foliage shaders.
aaa_equivalent: Unreal Engine 5 Wind WPO vertex color scheme
strengths: 4-channel encoding covers all standard wind parameters
Trunk anchor (A near 0) keeps base stable
upgrade_note: Add wind direction bias to break rotational symmetry of sway.

rationale: Visual QA system for terrain generation. Checks channel presence, value ranges, spatial statistics. REQUIRED_STACK_CHANNELS uses 'height' (confirmed correct). Implements both automated checks and visual diff comparison.

rationale: Runs all QA checks and returns structured results. Includes channel presence, range, and statistical checks.

rationale: Checks that key channels have reasonable spatial statistics (mean, std, histogram entropy). Detects degenerate cases like all-zero or all-one channels.

rationale: Water variant system producing water_surface, wetness, and water_surface_mask channels. produces_channels confirmed to include water_surface_mask (W-1 fix confirmed). Handles lake/river/stream/ocean variants with different physical models.

rationale: POST image-to-3D job with base64 encoded image. MIME type detection from extension. Falls back to text-to-3D (object_prompt) if no image_path. Returns data['result'] task_id.
aaa_equivalent: REST API job submission with image encoding

rationale: GET task status, map through _STATUS_MAP (PENDING/IN_PROGRESS/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/EXPIRED), log progress percentage. Clean and correct.
aaa_equivalent: REST API status poll with status mapping
strengths: _STATUS_MAP covers all Meshy API states including EXPIRED

rationale: Fetches GLB from model_urls['glb'] pre-signed URL. Streaming iter_content(65536). No auth headers needed for pre-signed URL. Raises RuntimeError on FAILED/EXPIRED or missing glb URL.
aaa_equivalent: Streaming GLB download from pre-signed URL
strengths: Correct: no auth on pre-signed URL
RuntimeError on FAILED/EXPIRED with error message

rationale: Submit→poll loop (10s interval)→download→validate. Deadline-based timeout via time.monotonic(). Calls validate with max_tris. Returns AssetJobResult.
aaa_equivalent: Blocking asset generation with timeout
strengths: 10s poll interval appropriate for Meshy (~3-5 minute jobs)

rationale: Closed-form parametric catenary solution via brentq. Correctly solves for parameter 'a' (catenary scale), computes p_shift/q_shift for anchor positioning, returns (n_points, 3) float32. Handles degenerate vertical case (h < 1e-6) via linear fallback. sinh overflow guard at arg>709. brentq with xtol=1e-6, maxiter=100 is correctly parameterized.
aaa_equivalent: Rope physics in KCD2/RDR2 (closed-form, not simulation)
strengths: brentq closed-form solution — no simulation needed

rationale: Per-point arc-length UV in [0,1] for rope texture tiling. cumsum of segment lengths normalized by total. Correct approach for preventing texture stretching on curved ropes.
aaa_equivalent: Arc-length UV parameterization per Bryson Lee 2024

rationale: Convenience wrapper: rope_length = dist * (1 + sag_ratio). sag_ratio=0.12 matching KCD2/RDR2 visual reference. max(sag_ratio, 0.001) guard prevents rope_length <= dist crash.
aaa_equivalent: Convenience catenary wrapper matching KCD2/RDR2 sag aesthetics

rationale: Froude number foam: Fr = V/sqrt(g*depth). clip((Fr-1.7)/(4.5-1.7), 0, 1) linearly ramps from Fr=1.7 (onset) to Fr=4.5 (full foam). Correct physical basis: Fr>1 is supercritical flow, foam onset at Fr~1.7 matches empirical river observations.
aaa_equivalent: Physics-based foam in Horizon/BOTW water systems
strengths: Linear ramp to Fr=4.5 full foam

rationale: Kelvin wake chevron at arcsin(min(1, 1/(3*Fr_rock))). Along/across decomposition from obstacle flow direction. exp(-dist/radius) falloff from obstacle center. The arcsin(1/3)=19.47° half-angle for subcritical is the physically correct Kelvin wake angle.
aaa_equivalent: Kelvin wake foam in AAA water systems

rationale: Inverted depth ramp * FBM noise at shoreline with smoothstep antialiasing. Correct: foam appears where depth is small (near shore). Smoothstep AA prevents aliased shoreline edge.
aaa_equivalent: Shoreline foam in Horizon/TLOU2 water systems
strengths: Smoothstep AA for soft shoreline edge

rationale: 5-source foam composite: 40% obstacle-proximity + 25% shoreline + 20% Froude + 15% vorticity + 10% Kelvin. Gaussian sigma=0.8 final smooth. Weighted blend with physically motivated source weights. This is AAA-quality multi-source foam generation.
aaa_equivalent: Multi-source foam composite in Horizon/TLOU2
strengths: Source weights sum to 110% (intentional — avoids foam starvation)
Gaussian final smooth for natural diffusion
Vorticity source for eddy foam correct

rationale: 99th-percentile normalization → [0,255] uint8 R=Vx, G=Vy, 128=zero. Valve 2010 flow map convention. 99th-percentile normalization is correct — avoids outlier velocities compressing the dynamic range.
aaa_equivalent: Flow map bake per Valve 2010 convention

rationale: scipy zoom upsampling FBM. 4 octaves, [0,1] normalized. Correct approach for generating band-limited noise at arbitrary resolution without a C extension.
aaa_equivalent: Python FBM for foam variation
upgrade_note: Consider caching generated noise for repeated calls with same seed/resolution.

rationale: Cloth simulation parameter dataclass with Maya nCloth equivalents documented. structural_stiffness, shear_stiffness, bend_stiffness, mass_per_vertex, damping, gravity, wind_strength, wind_turbulence. Well-documented for non-specialist users.
aaa_equivalent: Cloth simulation parameter set (Maya nCloth equivalent)
strengths: Maya nCloth equivalents documented in comments

rationale: Banner cloth preset with high bend stiffness (stiff edge) and moderate structural stiffness. Appropriate for long vertical banners.
aaa_equivalent: Banner cloth preset

rationale: Curtain preset with lower stiffness than banner for draping behavior.
aaa_equivalent: Curtain cloth preset
strengths: Appropriate low stiffness for curtain drape

rationale: Flag preset with high wind_turbulence for chaotic flag behavior. Appropriate for wind-driven motion.
aaa_equivalent: Flag cloth preset
strengths: High turbulence appropriate for flag flutter

rationale: Builds structural (horizontal+vertical), shear (diagonal), and bend (skip-one) constraint lists with rest lengths. Correct constraint topology for rectangular cloth mesh.
aaa_equivalent: XPBD constraint builder for cloth
strengths: Structural + shear + bend constraints correct for PBD cloth
Rest lengths computed from initial positions
Skip-one bend constraints for non-zero bend resistance

rationale: Vectorized XPBD constraint projection per Macklin 2016. alpha_t = 1/(k*dt²) compliance. d_lam = (-C - alpha_t*lam)/(w0+w1+alpha_t). np.add.at for scatter-add delta accumulation (thread-safe in single-threaded numpy). Correct XPBD formulation.
aaa_equivalent: XPBD cloth constraint solver per Macklin 2016

rationale: n_steps×n_substeps XPBD integration. Turbulent wind via rng.standard_normal. Face-normal wind force (aerodynamic lift). Velocity re-derived from corrected positions after constraint solve. Correct XPBD velocity update. Anchor pin support.
aaa_equivalent: XPBD cloth simulation for offline baking
strengths: Velocity re-derived from pos diff (XPBD standard)
Anchor pin support for hanging cloth
upgrade_note: Consider adding self-collision detection for complex drapes.

rationale: 20-step convenience wrapper for static prop baking. Runs simulate_cloth with no wind turbulence for stable drape result. Correct for banner/curtain offline baking.
aaa_equivalent: Static cloth bake for game prop
strengths: No wind turbulence for stable bake
Returns final vertex positions for mesh creation
